A.depoimento: I sent three spearmen to Santarem and two archers to Evora, hoping to seize both neutral villages this turn. The march is short, and victory should add much-needed wood and iron to my realm.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora to gain two villages and open routes to the interior. Keep a garrison in Lisboa for defense. Postpone building until after the new villages produce resources.

B.depoimento: Turn 1: I've launched simultaneous assaults on Tarragona and Girona with spearmen and archers respectively, exploiting counter bonuses. Barcelona builds two spearmen to replenish. The knights stay ready for rapid response.
B.plano: Both neutral villages attacked with counter-advantaged forces; they should fall next turn. Barcelona builds 2 spearmen to replenish. Keep 3 knights as mobile reserve. Next turn: secure new villages, scout further via Tarragona/Girona roads, and build archers/knights with accumulated iron.

A.depoimento: I marched the entire Lisboa garrison to Coimbra to seize the village and secure a forward base. I also ordered the production of two spearmen in Lisboa to replenish our forces. Santarem and Evora were held steady, awaiting future expansion.
A.plano: Next turn: expect Coimbra to fall with a garrison of ~4 troops. Rebuild Lisboa's spearmen to defend the capital. Hold Santarem and Evora; prepare to push toward Badajoz or Faro once we have more spear.

B.depoimento: Spearmen march on Castellon, archers storm Huesca — both arrive tomorrow. Barcelona sends spearmen to bolster Tarragona and forges two more. Three knights wait in the capital, a fist ready to strike. The northeast frontier pushes outward.
B.plano: Castellon and Huesca attacks en route (arrive turn 3). Zaragoza deferred. Tarragona reinforced with 2 spearmen from Barcelona. Capital built 2 spearmen, retains 3 knights. Turn 3: take Zaragoza with Tarragona's spearmen (5 avail), build knight at Barcelona (60 iron), scout Valencia/Teruel from Castellon and Pamplona from Huesca.

A.depoimento:
I ordered Lisboa and Santarem to train spearmen,
Evora to train one archer,
and sent Coimbra's three knights to take Porto.
This expands our territory and economy.
A.plano:
Next turn: capture Porto and gain its wood/iron.
Rebuild Coimbra's knights and garrison Porto.
Keep building spearmen in Lisboa and Santarem.
Prepare to assault Badajoz or Faro once we have enough spearmen.

B.depoimento: Sent spearmen from Tarragona to seize Zaragoza, exploiting knight weakness. Marched capital's elite knights and spearmen south to Tarragona as strike force. Moved Castellon's garrison to reinforce. Shifted Huesca's archers west to Girona where new spearmen are training. Economy focused on mixed arms: knight at Barcelona, archer at Tarragona, spearmen at Girona.
B.plano: Zaragoza attack en route with 3 spearmen (counter knight). Barcelona knights+spears and Castellon spears reinforcing Tarragona. Huesca archers moving to Girona to pair with new spearmen. Built knight at capital, archer at Tarragona, 2 spears at Girona. Turn 4: Zaragoza should fall. Consolidate at Tarragona for Valencia/Teruel push. Girona spearmen for Pamplona.

A.depoimento: I ordered construction of spearmen and archers in my home villages and sent forces to take Badajoz, Faro, Vigo, and Salamanca. Spearmen marched from Lisboa, archers from Evora, and knights from Porto to secure these towns.
A.plano: Capture the four visible neutrals to expand my realm. Build replacement troops in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, and Coimbra to keep my armies strong. Avoid overextending or attacking the enemy capital yet.

B.depoimento: Zaragoza secured. Knights dispatched to Castellon and Zaragoza for Valencia and Teruel. Spearmen converging on Huesca for Pamplona assault. Economy humming with spearmen production across the frontier.
B.plano: Knights en route to Castellon (for Valencia) and Zaragoza (for Teruel) arrive turn 5. Spearmen from Girona and Zaragoza reach Huesca turn 5, join newly built spearmen there. Turn 5: send Castellon knight to Valencia, Zaragoza knight to Teruel, all Huesca spearmen to Pamplona. Build more spearmen at forward bases; Barcelona knight ready turn 5.

A.depoimento:
This turn I ordered spearmen production in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra and an archer in Porto.
I sent two spearmen each from Santarem and Coimbra to Badajoz to join the marching force, aiming to seize the neutral next turn.
A.plano:
Capture Badajoz by turn 6 with reinforced spearmen.
Hold it and prepare to strike Faro and Toledo next.
Keep building spearmen in core villages; avoid overextending to Faro or Toledo until we have a base.

B.depoimento: Turn 5: Knight rides from Castellon to claim Valencia's archers. Huesca swells with Girona's spearmen, poised to strike Pamplona's knights next turn. Forges burn across our interior — spearmen rising at every forward base. The counter-march begins.
B.plano: Valencia attack launched with Castellon knight (counters archers). Held Huesca spearmen (4) for Girona's 2 arriving this turn; next turn send 6 spearmen to Pamplona (counters knights). Zaragoza keeps knight, builds spearmen; next turn build knight there, send 2 knights to Teruel. Barcelona knight building for reserve. All forward bases building spearmen for anti-knight push toward Burgos/Madrid.

A.depoimento: This turn we ordered spearman production across our villages, sent reinforcements to Badajoz, and launched a small spearman probe from Evora toward Faro to gauge enemy strength.
A.plano: Reinforce Badajoz with spearmen from Santarem and Coimbra to amass enough forces to capture Faro next turn. Continue building spearmen in all core villages for future offensives. Avoid premature attacks on Toledo or Madrid until we have sufficient numbers.

B.depoimento: We struck at Pamplona with a spearhead from Huesca, countering their knights. Our forges churn out spearmen across the realm, while Castellon forges a knight to challenge the archers of Teruel. The road westwards opens.
B.plano: Sent 8 spearmen from Huesca to take Pamplona (spearmen counter knights). Built spearmen in all interior villages; Castellon built a knight to threaten Teruel's archers next turn. Next turn: consolidate Pamplona, move Castellon knight toward Teruel, consider sending Zaragoza knight with it. Keep building spearmen in forward bases for Burgos/Madrid push. Monitor unexplored west for enemy movement.

A.depoimento:
I ordered spearmen production in all my villages.
I let Evora's detachment advance on Faro, while preparing a strong strike from Lisboa and Santarem for next turn.
Holding the line while preparing the hammer.
A.plano:
Let Evora's spearmen soften Faro next turn.
Then hit Faro with Lisboa's mass and Toledo with Santarem's force.
Build spearmen everywhere to replenish.
Avoid exposing core villages.

B.depoimento: Pamplona conquistada. Agora a engrenagem gira: lanças fluem de Zaragoza->Huesca->Pamplona para esmagar Burgos, enquanto cavaleiros se concentram em Zaragoza e Valencia para varrer Teruel e Murcia. O ferro de Girona e Huesca alimenta a máquina. O oeste ainda é névoa, mas a rede de estradas mostra o caminho.
B.plano: Pamplona receberá 2 lanças de Huesca (total 7) -> enviar 7 lanças p/ Burgos (1 turno) e tomar. Zaragoza terá 2 cavaleiros (1 novo) -> enviar 2 p/ Teruel (1 turno) e tomar arqueros. Valencia terá 2 cavaleiros (1 de Castellon) -> enviar 2 p/ Murcia (1 turno) e tomar. Huesca receberá 4 lanças de Zaragoza + 2 novas = 6 lanças; next turn mandar p/ Pamplona p/ reforçar p/ Madrid. Construir lanças em todas; cavaleiros em Zaragoza/Huesca p/ Madrid pós-Teruel. Monitorar oeste inexplorado.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered spear production in all my villages to replenish losses. I sent spears from Badajoz and Evora to retake Faro, and reinforced the force heading to Toledo with troops from Santarem and Salamanca. I held back my knights for future fast strikes.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce Faro and Toledo, continue spear production, prepare to attack Cordoba and Burgos with knights, avoid exposing core villages.

B.depoimento: Lançamos três ofensivas cirúrgicas: lanças de Pamplona varrem Burgos, cavaleiros de Zaragoza e Valencia esmagam arqueiros em Teruel e Murcia. A economia ronca produzindo lanças em massa e um cavaleiro em Huesca. O cerco ao norte aperta; o oeste inexplorado espera.
B.plano: Três ataques simultâneos: Pamplona->Burgos (7 lanças contra 4 cavaleiros, vantagem 1.5x), Zaragoza->Teruel e Valencia->Murcia (2 cavaleiros cada contra 3 arqueiros, vantagem 1.5x). Construindo lanças na maioria, arqueiros em Tarragona, cavaleiro em Huesca. Próximo turno: consolidar ganhos, enviar Huesca->Pamplona reforçar, preparar avanço p/ Madrid (cavaleiros) e explorar oeste via Toledo/Salamanca.

A.depoimento: Depoimento: Built archers in Porto, a knight in Vigo, and spearmen in Lisboa. Sent troops to seize Sevilha, Cordoba, Madrid, and Burgos, while existing marches strengthen Toledo.
A.plano: Plano: Capture Sevilha, Cordoba, Madrid, Burgos using mixed forces; reinforce Toledo with existing marches; build archers in Porto and a knight in Vigo; keep core villages defended; avoid attacking capital or unexplored lands this turn.

B.depoimento: Consolidamos as conquistas recentes e iniciamos a produção em massa de cavaleiros. Lançamos três cavaleiros contra Córdova para bater o inimigo. Zaragoza vira nosso punho blindado. Burgos vai sangrar, mas voltaremos com lanças. O oeste nos espera.
B.plano: Construí cavaleiros em todas as aldeias com recursos (8 no total). Enviei cavaleiros de Murcia, Teruel e Castellon para Córdova (chegam em 1, 2 e 3 turnos) para tomar antes do inimigo. Reforcei Zaragoza com cavaleiros de Huesca e Tarragona (chegam turno 10) criando reserva móvel. Lanças de Zaragoza e Pamplona marcham para Burgos (chegam turno 11) para contra-atacar se cair. Cavaleiros de Barcelona vão para Tarragona. Próximo turno: contra-atacar Burgos, avançar cavaleiros de Zaragoza para Madrid/Toledo, explorar oeste via Teruel-Toledo-Salamanca.

A.depoimento: I marched from Toledo to seize the empty Teruel, ordered archer production in nine villages to strengthen our army, and held my core defenses while waiting for incoming marches.
A.plano: Capture Teruel, build archers in nine villages to boost future firepower, reinforce Toledo with incoming marches, avoid attacking capital or unexplored lands this turn, let enemy take Cordoba and Burgos for now.

B.depoimento: Defesa desesperada em Teruel: enviei toda cavalaria de Zaragoza e lanças de Murcia para segurar a fronteira nua. Burgos recebe reforço de cavaleiro de Pamplona. A corrente de cavaleiros move-se para leste: Barcelona alimenta Tarragona, que alimenta Zaragoza, Huesca e Castellon completam o ciclo. Lanças nascem nas fronteiras expostas. Córdoba é sacrifício calculado.
B.plano: Teruel é prioridade máxima: 4 cavaleiros de Zaragoza + 4 lanças de Murcia chegam turno 11, 2 lanças ficam prontas turno 11. Inimigo chega turno 12. Burgos: 11 lanças + 1 cavaleiro chegam turno 11, 2 lanças nascendo. Cavaleiros em rotação Barcelona→Tarragona→Zaragoza→Teruel. Córdova provavelmente perdida. Próximo turno: se Teruel segurar, avançar cavaleiros para Toledo; monitorar Madrid (neutro, 3 cavaleiros) para tomar com lanças de Burgos.

B.depoimento: Reinforced Teruel with all available fast cavalry from Zaragoza and Castellon. Built knights in interior and spearmen on borders. Enemy marching on Teruel, Madrid, Cordoba. We brace for impact.
B.plano: Teruel defense prioritized: 4 knights from Zaragoza + 1 knight from Castellon + 4 spearmen from Murcia arrive turn 12. Enemy army also arrives turn 12. If Teruel holds, next turn send knights to Toledo. Burgos reinforced with 1 knight build; monitor Vigo. Build spearmen in interior for garrison depth. Madrid and Cordoba likely lost to enemy.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent four spearmen from Madrid to Zaragoza, trained five archers in Badajoz, and sent a spear from Salamanca to bolster Madrid's defenses.
A.plano: Next turn: aim to capture Zaragoza with the spear attack from Madrid, have archers ready in Badajoz for a future strike on Murcia, keep Madrid reinforced, avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: Struck at the enemy heart: knights race to Madrid and Toledo while Zaragoza braces for impact. Teruel gave its all. The northern front holds.
B.plano: Zaragoza reinforced with 6 knights arriving T13 vs enemy T14. Madrid/Toledo attacked with knights (Madrid 4, Toledo 3) arriving T13. Built knights everywhere, spearmen in Burgos. Teruel emptied of knights but holds with 7 spear. Watch Vigo threat on Burgos. Next: consolidate Madrid/Toledo, push to Salamanca/Badajoz.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained spearmen in all my villages and sent six spearmen from Badajoz to capture Toledo.
A.plano: Next turn: consolidate Toledo, build defenses there, prepare attack on Madrid from Salamanca/Cordoba, keep Badajoz reinforced, avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: We reinforced Zaragoza with 5 knights and Madrid with 2 knights to meet incoming enemy armies. Built knights across the realm and spearmen on the frontiers. Toledo stands empty but ready to rebuild. The enemy strikes at three fronts; we stand ready.
B.plano: Defended Zaragoza and Madrid with knight reinforcements from Teruel, Huesca, Toledo, Tarragona. Built knights in all capable villages, spearmen in Castellon and Madrid. Toledo emptied but will reinforce next turn. Enemy armies arrive T14 at Zaragoza and Madrid, T15 at Toledo. Next: hold gains, then push to Salamanca/Badajoz/Cordoba.

A.depoimento: This turn I built spears and archers across my kingdoms, sent archers from Vigo to Burgos and from Cordoba to Murcia, and held my troops ready to seize Toledo with the marching spearmen.
A.plano: Next turn: reinforce Toledo garrison, prepare attack on Madrid via Toledo, build more archers for Burgos/Murcia, keep border defenses strong.

A.depoimento: This turn I built spearmen in Badajoz, Salamanca, Cordoba, Sevilha and Toledo, and sent reinforcements from Badajoz to Toledo and from Sevilha to Cordoba to mass troops for strikes on Madrid and Murcia.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Madrid with Toledo's forces and Murcia with Cordoba's forces. Keep Salamanca and Vigo defended. Do not attempt Burgos or Teruel yet.

B.depoimento: We struck at Toledo with a swift knight charge from Madrid, while reinforcing our borders. Zaragoza's knights rush to Madrid's aid. Archers rise in every village to counter the enemy's spearmen. The push for 18 villages begins.
B.plano: Toledo attacked with 5 knights from Madrid (1 turn). Zaragoza sends 10 knights to reinforce Madrid. Valencia and Castellon send knights to bolster Murcia and Teruel. Tarragona sends knights to Zaragoza. Built 1 archer in every village to counter enemy spearmen. Next turn: secure Toledo, hit Cordoba from Madrid/Murcia, press Salamanca from Madrid, move archers forward, scout Coimbra via Salamanca.

A.depoimento:
Ordered every village to produce two spearmen, swelling our ranks.
Sent Badajoz's six spearmen and six archers toward Murcia, expecting victory in two turns.
A.plano:
Build spearmen in all villages to increase strength.
Send Badajoz's force to capture Murcia in two turns; prepare border villages for future Madrid assault.

B.depoimento: We brace for the enemy march on Murcia, flooding our borders with arrows. Archers rise in every village, converging on Madrid to break the spearmen wall. The knights ride to shield Murcia while the bows are readied.
B.plano: Built 2 archers in every village. Sent Teruel's 3 knights to Murcia (1 turn). Sent Zaragoza's 3 archers, Teruel's 1 archer, Burgos' 1 archer to Madrid to mass archers. Sent 5 knights from Madrid to Murcia (2 turns). Next turn: launch archer attack on Toledo from Madrid, build more archers, watch Murcia defense.

A.depoimento:
This turn I ordered spearmen production in every owned village, bolstering our garrisons.
No troops were sent as we focus on building up for a stronger offensive soon.
A.plano:
Continue building spearmen in all villages to increase strength.
Next turn, prepare a larger assault on Murcia using accumulated forces from Cordoba and Badajoz, while keeping border villages ready for future pushes toward Burgos and Madrid.

B.depoimento: Launched a decisive strike on Toledo with a mixed archer-knight force from Madrid, exploiting the archer advantage over spearmen. Reinforced Murcia with spearmen and archers ahead of the enemy arrival. Economy geared toward knight production for mobile reserves.
B.plano: Attacked Toledo with 6 archers + 6 knights from Madrid (archer-majority counters spearmen). Built knights in most villages, archers in Madrid/Tarragona/Zaragoza/Pamplona. Sent 7 spearmen from Teruel and 3 archers from Valencia to reinforce Murcia before enemy arrival in 3 turns. Next turn: consolidate archers in Madrid, prepare for Salamanca/Badajoz, monitor Murcia defense.

A.depoimento: This turn I dispatched 14 spearmen and 2 archers from Salamanca to take Madrid, and 20 spearmen and 1 archer from Faro to seize Toledo. I also ordered mass archer production across my realms to prepare for future pushes against Burgos and beyond.
A.plano: Capture Madrid and Toledo this turn with forces from Salamanca and Faro. Keep garrisons of 6 spears in Salamanca and Faro to defend. Avoid attacking Burgos or Murcia due to high defense. Build archers in all villages to increase future strength.

A.depoimento: Sent archers to reinforce Toledo attack. Built archers and spears in home villages. Accepting likely loss at Madrid to preserve resources for future turns.
A.plano: Capture Toledo this turn by sending archers from Badajoz, Salamanca, Cordoba. Accept loss at Madrid. Build archers in all villages (using available wood) and add spears where wood remains. Keep garrisons for defense.

B.depoimento: Enviou cavaleiros para segurar Toledo, Madrid e Murcia contra seis exércitos inimigos. Construiu arqueiros nas vilas de fronteira para neutralizar lanceiros. A linha está armada.
B.plano: Reforçei Toledo, Madrid e Murcia com cavaleiros (chegam turno 21) e arqueiros (chegam turno 22). Construí arqueiros nas fronteiras para contra lanças. Próximo turno: avaliar baixas, considerar contra-ataque em Badajoz/Salamanca, continuar produzindo cavaleiros no interior.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of a knight in each of my villages, using available wood and iron. No troops were sent as I chose to fortify my positions first. Ready to strike soon.
A.plano: Build knights in all villages to boost anti-archer strength. Keep garrisons strong; avoid sending troops this turn to prevent weakening defenses. Next turn, assess enemy movements and prepare spears for countering knights.

B.depoimento: O inimigo bateu em nossas portas e quebrou a cara. Agora é nossa vez: lanço arqueiros contra Badajoz e Salamanca, explorando sua fraqueza a lanças. O interior forja cavaleiros para o avanço que virá.
B.plano: Ataque Badajoz e Salamanca com arqueiros (contam lanças). Reforços de cavaleiros chegam às fronteiras. Próximo turno: avaliar resultados, preparar avanço para Santarém/Coimbra, manter produção de arqueiros nas fronteiras e cavaleiros no interior.

A.depoimento: Sent archer squads to Badajoz and Salamanca, a spearman force to Toledo, and ordered knights built in all villages to strengthen our army.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz, Salamanca, Toledo to raise held villages to 12. Keep garrisons strong after sends. Avoid attacking Burgos or Madrid this turn due to insufficient force. Build knights everywhere to boost anti-archer power.

B.depoimento: Reforços de emergência partem para Badajoz e Salamanca enquanto exércitos inimigos marcham contra nossas novas conquistas. Cavaleiros velozes de Toledo e Madrid chegam a tempo da primeira onda; Murcia e Burgos cobrem a segunda. Forjas em todo o reino produzem arqueiros para triturar as hordas de lanceiros do inimigo.
B.plano: Defesa urgente: cavaleiros de Toledo e Madrid chegam a Badajoz e Salamanca no turno 23 (antes da 1ª onda). Murcia e Burgos chegam no turno 24 (2ª onda). Produção massiva de arqueiros para contra-atacar lanças inimigas. Próximo turno: avaliar baixas, consolidar fronteiras e preparar investida em Santarém/Faro/Córdoba.

B.depoimento: Reforcei Badajoz com arqueiros de Toledo e Salamanca com cavaleiros e arqueiros de Madrid. Lancei ataque a Córdova com 9 arqueiros de Múrcia, explorando sua fraqueza contra lanças. Iniciei produção massiva de arqueiros em todo o reino. A guerra esquenta nas fronteiras.
B.plano: Defesa prioritária: Badajoz e Salamanca reforçados contra ataques inimigos. Ataque a Córdova com 9 arqueiros de Múrcia para explorar fraqueza. Produção de arqueiros em todas as vilas para contra lanças. Próximo turno: avaliar baixas, consolidar e preparar investidas em Santarém e Faro a partir de Badajoz.

A.depoimento: I ordered spearmen production in every village to boost reserves. I sent twenty spearmen from Sevilha to strengthen Cordoba against the approaching enemy army, and dispatched a knight from Cordoba to take the weakly held Toledo.
A.plano: Reinforce Cordoba with spearmen from Sevilha and send a knight to capture Toledo. Build spearmen in all villages for future strength. Do not launch other offensives or build costly units now.

B.depoimento: Toledo se blinda com chuva de flechas vinda do oeste e norte. Múrcia lança seus cavaleiros ao coração de Córdova. A fronteira sul treme, mas a linha segura.
B.plano: Toledo reforçado com arqueiros de Badajoz e Salamanca para contra lanças inimigas. Cavaleiros de Múrcia apoiam arqueiros em Córdova. Produção focada em arqueiros na fronteira e cavaleiros no interior. Próximo turno: avaliar batalhas em Toledo e Córdova; se Toledo segurar, contra-atacar Santarém/Faro com cavaleiros; se Córdova cair, avançar para Sevilha.

A.depoimento: I ordered the construction of two spearmen in each of my villages to strengthen our reserves. I sent fourteen spearmen from Santarem to take Badajoz and eight spearmen from Cordoba to secure Madrid. I held back other offensives to focus on these two objectives.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz and Madrid to raise our held villages to 11. Build two spearmen in every village to replenish stocks. Avoid other attacks and expensive units until we have more forces.

B.depoimento: O inimigo marcha sobre Badajoz e Madrid, mas respondemos com ferro e flecha. Toledo lança seus arqueiros contra Córdova, enquanto o interior envia cavaleiros para salvar a capital. A guerra esquenta nas fronteiras.
B.plano: Reforços a Badajoz (Salamanca+Toledo) e Madrid (Zaragoza, Huesca, Pamplona, Teruel, Burgos) contra exércitos inimigos. Ataque a Córdova com 14 arqueiros de Toledo. Construção de arqueiros na fronteira e cavaleiros no interior. Próximo turno: resolver batalhas; se Badajoz segurar, atacar Santarém/Faro; se Córdova cair, avançar para Sevilha; reforçar Toledo e Salamanca.

A.depoimento:
This turn we mustered our armies and struck at Salamanca, Toledo and Burgos.
Each assault broke the enemy lines and added three villages to our realm.
Our homesteads grew stronger as new spearmen took up arms.
The momentum is ours.
A.plano:
Next turn, reinforce Santarem, Faro and Cordoba with fresh troops.
Continue building spearmen in every village.
Mass forces for a decisive strike on Badajoz.
Hold off on Madrid until we outnumber the enemy.

B.depoimento: Enviamos todos os cavaleiros e arqueiros disponíveis para segurar Madrid contra o exército iminente. Reforçamos Salamanca e Toledo com tropas de Badajoz e Burgos. Tomamos Vigo sem luta e atacamos Córdova com arqueiros que contam lanças. Construímos cavaleiros no interior e arqueiros nas fronteiras. A guerra esquenta.
B.plano: Reforços massivos a Madrid (chega em 1 turno), Salamanca e Toledo (2 turnos) e Burgos (3). Captura de Vigo (vazio) e ataque a Córdova com arqueiros de Múrcia. Construção de cavaleiros no interior e arqueiros na fronteira. Próximo turno: avaliar batalhas, se Madrid segurar avançar para Sevilha/Evora; reforçar Salamanca e Toledo com tropas de Badajoz e Madrid; vigiar exércitos inimigos vindos de Lisboa/Porto.

A.depoimento: Today we launched a coordinated assault on Badajoz using Santarem and Faro’s armies, while sending Sevilha’s and Porto’s troops to bolster Cordoba and Vigo. We also ordered spearmen production in every village to swell our ranks for future pushes.
A.plano: Next turn, hold Badajoz and reinforce it with fresh troops. Continue building spearmen in all villages. Prepare to assault Salamanca with the arriving army from Coimbra. Do not split forces weakly; keep garrisons strong enough to repel enemy incursions.

B.depoimento: Reforcei Badajoz com todo o exército de Toledo, enquanto Madrid despacha cavaleiros para Salamanca, Toledo e Burgos. Burgos envia arqueiros para limpar Vigo. Construí cavaleiros nas vilas de fronteira com ferro sobrando e arqueiros no interior. Agora é segurar a linha e preparar a tomada das vilas vazias a oeste.
B.plano: Defesa prioritária: Toledo envia tudo para Badajoz (2 exércitos inimigos); Madrid envia cavaleiros para Salamanca, Toledo e Burgos (chegam no turno do ataque). Burgos manda arqueiros para Vigo (contra lanças). Construção de cavaleiros nas fronteiras ricas em ferro e arqueiros no interior. Próximo turno: avaliar batalhas, se Badajoz segurar, tomar Santarém e Faro com cavaleiros de Badajoz/Salamanca; reforçar Burgos com mais cavaleiros de Madrid; vigiar exércitos vindos de Lisboa/Porto.

B.depoimento: O inimigo conquistou Badajoz e Salamanca e marcha sobre Burgos. Respondi com uma parede de arqueiros em Burgos para contrapor as lanças de Vigo, enquanto Madrid golpeia Salamanca com doze arqueiros. O ferro de Toledo e Murcia alimenta cavaleiros; o interior produz arqueiros. A guerra aperta, mas a linha segura.
B.plano: Defesa urgente em Burgos: exército inimigo chega no turno 29. Reforcei com arqueiros de Madrid, Pamplona, Zaragoza e Toledo para tornar arqueiros o tipo majoritário (contra lanças de Vigo). Madrid ataca Salamanca com 12 arqueiros (vantagem contra lanças, defesa 30). Toledo mantém 8 cavaleiros de reserva. Construção foca em arqueiros no interior e cavaleiros nas fronteiras ricas em ferro. Próximo turno: avaliar batalha de Burgos, se vencer, avançar com cavaleiros de Toledo/Madrid sobre Badajoz/Córdoba; vigiar Lisboa/Porto.

A.depoimento: Sent two knights from Vigo to Burgos to strengthen its defenses. Mobilized all available troops from Badajoz toward Toledo to seize the enemy-held city. Ordered Lisboa to forge two new knights for future campaigns.
A.plano: Reinforce Burgos with knights from Vigo to defend against incoming enemy army and prepare for future assault on Zaragoza. Launch full-force expedition from Badajoz to capture Toledo, expecting to leave a strong garrison. Produce two knights in Lisboa to bolster long-term offensive capacity. Avoid attacking Salamanca or Zaragoza this turn due to insufficient force.

Burgos: meu exército fraco (3 lanças, 1 arqueiro) chega junto com inimigo - provável perda, não reforçar suicídio. Construção: cavaleiros nas fronteiras ricas em ferro (Salamanca, Toledo, Madrid), arqueiros no interior e fronteiras pobres contra lanças inimigas (Vigo, Coimbra, Córdova). Próximo: se Badajoz cair, avançar arqueiros sobre Córdova/Faro/Santarém; segurar Toledo a todo custo.

Building knights in all border villages (Badajoz, Salamanca, Toledo, Zaragoza, Pamplona, Madrid) and archers in interior (Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona).
